rationale: go-jose JWK RSA parsing DoS. The care-caddy binary carries github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v3 v3.0.5 only through caddypki (smallstep/certificates, go.step.sm/crypto); no fixed v3 release exists. The deployed Caddyfile uses no acme_server, pki app or internal issuer, so that JWK parsing is not reachable. go-jose/v4 is pinned to the fixed 4.1.6. ADR-0041 addendum of 28 October 2026.

libssl3t64 and openssl-provider-legacy 3.5.9-1~deb13u1 in the API distroless Debian 13 runtime; Debian has no fixed package yet (status affected). Both flaws are denial of service in OpenSSL's QUIC stack. Node.js uses its bundled OpenSSL, so the system libssl is loaded only by the Prisma query engine for its TCP connection to PostgreSQL, which never uses QUIC, and the API serves no QUIC listener (Caddy terminates HTTP/3 in Go). ADR-0057 addendum of 27 November 2026.
